comparison.objective: Separate finishing media from workpieces, versus safely removing a tube from a still-spinning centrifuge.
comparison.physical_skill: Screen agitation and spill control versus stopping a rotor, opening a lid and extracting a tube from a hazardous mechanism.
comparison.success_condition: Recovery and retention versus rotor stopped before access and tube upright in a rack.
comparison.reason: The record tests machine-state safety and discrete extraction rather than separation.
